table.VID_WEB_WARNING: Copyright warning: this file was found on the open web, on {host}. The platform could not check who owns it or whether it may be reused, and the licence the page states, if any, was not checked. If you approve it and publish the video, the video may be taken down and your account may receive a copyright strike. Approve it only if you know you may use it. Source page: {page}
table.VID_WEB_NOT_BUILT: The web search is not set up here; the licensed sources were searched.
table.VID_WEB_NO_WEB: The chosen model cannot search the web here; the licensed sources were searched.
table.VID_WEB_NEEDS_OWN: This file needs its own approval after the warning.
table.VID_WEB_PREVIEW: These words will be sent to the web search of the model that runs it and to that model's provider, and this computer will then download a preview of each picture found (up to 16 MiB each) from the sites found: {words}.
table.VID_WEB_LIMIT: The web search already ran {count} times today, the limit of this project.
table.VID_WEB_FAILED: The web search did not finish; nothing was kept.
table.VID_STOCK_NO_PICTURE: No picture for {slots}: these slots stay empty in the video. To fill one, give it new words and search again, or choose another option in the caption review.
table.VID_WEB_NOTHING: The web search found no picture that could be used.
